word_rule: per seed: 150-frame window centred on the word (mc_train.human_batch_fixed geometry, raw pad 0.0), sigmoid(perc), mean of the top-3 kept frames in the word; then the mean over seeds
gate_rule: gate V: model frame kept if a REAPER-low (minf0 25, maxf0 500) voiced time lies within +-15 ms of its centre; >= 2 kept frames, else INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT
threshold_provenance: no operating threshold is part of the release; the final-test tau_high 0.30995 is an F4 (not F4N2) EARS-pool percentile and must not be reused as an F4N2 probability
